'''Master Torturer''' was a title given to the foremost [[Torture/Legends|interrogator]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Department of Punishment]]. As of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Sir/Legends|Sir]] [[Vengnar Heiff]] held this title.
